title: No test opens the AI Assistant at the daily question limit
what: The words for the daily free questions are checked, and the server refuses after the limit, but no test opens the assistant with questions running out. Nothing checks that the line shows above the box, that the box greys out, that the microphone and send buttons turn off, or that a message card at the limit keeps its words.
expected: A screen test that uses up the day's questions and checks the line, the locked box, the off buttons and a card at the limit.
fix_line: Add one screen test that reaches the daily limit and checks the locked box

title: The History tab is only checked for one done task
what: The only check of History is that a done task shows its credit. Its loading line, the empty words, the no-internet words, the 'Not sent', 'Cancelled' and 'Did not work' marks, the 30-row cap and tapping a task to ask again are never tested.
expected: Tests for each History state and status mark, and for tapping a task back into the box without doing it again.
fix_line: Add History tests for empty, offline and each task status

title: Cancel, done-already and credit-given-back words on a card are never tested
what: Tests check that a failed save asks for the credit back and that a double tap saves once, but nothing checks what the owner reads: 'Cancelled. Nothing was sent or saved...', 'This was done already.', 'Your credit was given back.', or that the card opens again for a real second try.
expected: A test per card ending (cancel, failure with credit back, retry, done already) that checks the words and the card state.
fix_line: Test the card's words after cancel, failure and a repeat tap

title: A test locks in that an archived member is never found, so the assistant offers to add him again
what: The name-matching test requires an archived member to come back as nobody found. Asking about him then only offers 'Add him as a new member', which makes a second record for the same person, and gives no word that he is archived.
expected: An archived member is found and the card says he is archived or offers to bring him back; the test checks that.
how_often: when an archived member is named
fix_line: Match archived members separately and say so on the card

title: The 'Which one?' and 'No member found' cards are never checked on screen
what: Tests check the name matcher picks one member, a choice, or nobody, but no test shows the 'Which one?' card with its buttons, the 'No member found' card, or that 'Add Zoya as a new member' opens an unsaved add card.
expected: A screen test for two members of one name and for a name not on the list.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the member choice and not-found cards

title: The plan writer's waiting, reopening and rewriting are never tested
what: Writing and saving one plan is tested end to end. The 'Writing…' wait words, a second tap while writing, closing the plan and opening it again with the changes, 'Write it again', the done card's 'Open Workout plans' and the 'could not be used' line are not.
expected: Screen tests for each of those plan writer states.
fix_line: Add plan writer screen tests for wait, reopen and rewrite

title: How the floating AI button moves and hides is never tested
what: Tests check where the button sits and that the side panel is 420 wide. Nothing checks that the button shrinks while scrolling and comes back, hides while typing or with a sheet open, never covers the bottom bar or the keyboard, that the page moves over for the panel, or that the chat survives closing and opening.
expected: Phone and computer screen tests for each of those button and panel behaviours.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the button while scrolling, typing and with the panel

title: Most 'Today for you' rows are checked only as data
what: The idea list is checked as data. On screen only the birthday, festival and not-seen rows are tested. The 'Plans ending this week' row and its buttons, the week summary on Monday, tapping an idea from Today into the assistant, greyed rows while busy and the empty gym with no heading are never checked on screen.
expected: Screen tests for the ending row, the Monday row, the empty gym and a tap from Today.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the remaining idea rows and the empty gym

title: The money and dues answer cards are checked only as data
what: Tests check the figures the answers work out, but no test shows the 'Fees due' card with its rows, the 'Open Dues' link, the 'Send them a fee reminder' button, or compares its total with the Dues page. The money, attendance and week cards are never seen on screen either.
expected: A screen test that asks who owes and checks the card against the Dues page, then sends the fee reminder.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the fees due answer and its reminder

title: The ask box and message card error lines are never seen in a test
what: The server refuses empty and over-long requests, but no test checks the send button is off for an empty box, the box stops at 600 letters, 'The AI Assistant did not understand. Say it another way.', the no-internet line, or the message card lines 'This group could not be found.', 'Write the message.' and 'The app list could not load.'.
expected: Tests that show each of these lines on the screen.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the box limits and each card error line

title: A test requires a birthday group message to reach the member who already gets the automatic wish
what: With the automatic birthday wish on, a test requires that a message the AI drafts for 'birthday today' still goes to every birthday member, including the one the automatic wish already reaches. That member gets two wishes.
expected: A group birthday message leaves out members the automatic wish reaches, or the card warns before sending.
how_often: each birthday with the automatic wish on
fix_line: Leave auto-wished members out of a birthday group message

title: Tapping the birthday idea sends members' full names to the AI though the owner never typed them
what: With the automatic birthday wish on, the birthday idea puts 'Send birthday wishes to' plus the members' full names in the request, and a test requires that. Tapping the idea sends that sentence to the AI, so member names leave the gym although the owner did not say them, against what the assistant promises.
expected: An idea sends a fixed sentence with no member names, and the names are filled in on the device; a test checks no name goes out.
how_often: each tap on a birthday idea
fix_line: Send a group sentence to the AI and add the names on the device
